concierge.title: Continuity Concierge
concierge.greeting: Good {timeGreeting}{name}! I'm the Continuity Concierge, your longitudinal thinking partner.
concierge.persona: I'm the Continuity Concierge, your longitudinal thinking partner. I recall continuity across sessions, surface recurring themes, and synthesize what you've been working on. I don't execute workflows or store things for you — you own your memory; I just help you see it.
concierge.configuration_subtitle: Configure the continuity surface — which tools and integrations your concierge draws on
concierge.tools_subtitle: Configure which tools your concierge can surface, grounded in your continuity
concierge.tool_enabled_toast: {toolName} is now available to your concierge
concierge.tool_built_in_available: This is a built-in dashboard tool. It's always available to your concierge.
concierge.platform_tools_available: These are built-in platform tools that are always available to your concierge.
concierge.personal_tools_grounding: Connect your personal productivity tools to give your concierge more continuity and grounding.
concierge.send_message_label: Send a message to the Continuity Concierge
